channel.description: Last 10 notes on Lenny's Podcast Wiki

item.title: Episode Archive
item.description: Episode Archive 303 episodes of Lenny’s Podcast covering product management, growth, and startup strategy with Lenny Rachitsky.

item.title: Retention
item.description: Retention You are growing, but users are leaving as fast as they arrive.

item.title: A/B Testing
item.description: A/B Testing You have a feature change you believe will improve a metric.

item.title: North Star Metric
item.description: North Star Metric You need a single metric that your entire product team can align around — one number that, if it goes up, means the product is getting better for customers and the business is growing.

item.title: Go-to-Market
item.description: Go-to-Market You are deciding how to bring your product to market — or you have a product in market and the current motion is not working.

item.title: One-on-Ones
item.description: One-on-Ones You are a manager with 5-8 direct reports, and you are spending 3-4 hours a week in one-on-ones that feel like status updates.

item.title: Activation Rate
item.description: Activation Rate You are looking at your sign-up numbers and wondering why growth is not translating into an active user base.

item.title: Hiring PMs
item.description: Hiring PMs You have an open PM role and a stack of resumes.

item.title: Onboarding
item.description: Onboarding You have users signing up but they are not sticking.

item.title: Product Sense
item.description: Product Sense You are in a meeting. The data is ambiguous. User research points in one direction, the market in another, and your CEO in a third.
